verdict.rationale: Cerebras documents passing images to vision-capable models, using the standard OpenAI image_url content shape with base64 data URIs. That is first-party support for vision input beyond text chat. The evidence shows no audio models or image-generation models, so the platform covers only one of the multimodal modalities the story names. missing for 10: audio (speech-to-text/TTS) model support, image-generation models, detail on which vision models are available and their limits, independent or hands-on corroboration of vision input.
